title: The 8 Best Cordless Jigsaw 2026
metaDescription: Our 8 picks for cordless jigsaw 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at cordless jigsaw 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: DEWALT DCS334B 20V MAX XR Brushless Jigsaw
products.blurb: Key specs: 20V MAX XR brushless motor, 0-3,200 SPM variable speed, 4-position orbital action.
strengths: XR brushless motor maintains consistent cutting speed under load in hardwood
4-position orbital action from straight to highly aggressive for fastest material removal
All-metal lever-action keyless blade clamp is among the fastest blade swaps in the category
DEWALT 20V MAX ecosystem -- one battery platform across the entire tool line
limitations: High price compared to non-XR DEWALT jigsaws
Battery not included in tool-only purchase
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: Bosch GST18V-47N 18V Barrel-Grip Jig Saw
products.blurb: Key specs: 18V brushless-compatible motor, 550-2,700 SPM, Barrel-grip design.
strengths: Barrel-grip design places the hand directly above the blade for precise control
Variable speed dial covers gentle curves through aggressive straight cuts
Bosch blade clamp system is among the fastest blade swaps in the category
Bosch 18V ecosystem -- battery compatibility across all Bosch professional 18V tools
limitations: Lower max SPM than the DEWALT and top-tier competitors
Barrel grip requires an adjustment period for top-handle users

products.name: Makita XVJ03Z 18V LXT Cordless Jigsaw
products.blurb: Key specs: 18V LXT brushless, 0-2,600 SPM variable speed, 3-position orbital action.
strengths: LED blade light illuminates the cut line in shadowed workpiece areas
3-position orbital action is sufficient for most woodworking applications
Makita LXT battery ecosystem -- largest 18V battery library in the industry
Lower vibration than Milwaukee at equivalent power output
limitations: 2,600 SPM max is lower than Milwaukee (3,500) for faster cuts in softwood
3-position vs 4-position orbital action -- slight disadvantage in versatility

products.name: Greenworks 24V Brushless Cordless Jig Saw with 6 Blades
products.blurb: Key specs: Brushless motor, 4 orbital settings, 1-inch stroke length.
strengths: Brushless motor delivers up to 3,000 SPM with better efficiency than brushed competitors at this price
4 orbital settings cover gentle curves through aggressive straight cuts
Tool-free blade changing speeds up switching between blade types
Lower cost of entry into a brushless cordless jigsaw than the major professional brands
limitations: Smaller battery ecosystem than Milwaukee, DEWALT, or Makita
Less refined vibration damping than premium professional brands

products.name: WEN 20661 20V Max Cordless Jigsaw with Battery and Charger
products.blurb: Key specs: 20V Max battery included, Variable-pressure trigger, 0-2,400 SPM.
strengths: Lowest price in the cordless jigsaw category, and includes battery and charger
Variable-pressure trigger allows fine speed control by feel
Tool-free bevel and blade changes handle most woodworking jigsaw tasks
Good for woodworkers who use a jigsaw occasionally rather than daily
limitations: Lower max SPM than DEWALT or Makita
Less refined vibration damping than premium brands
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: Festool Carvex PSC 420 EBQ Cordless Jigsaw
products.blurb: Key specs: Festool 18V system, 0-2,700 SPM, 5-position orbital.
strengths: 5-position orbital -- the widest orbital range in the category
Lowest vibration of anyjigsaw -- measurable difference in operator fatigue
Festool guide rail compatibility enables straight cuts as precise as a track saw
Highest dust extraction efficiency with Festool CT extractor
limitations: Guide rail compatibility only useful if also invested in Festool rail system
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: Metabo HPT CJ18DSLQ4 18V Cordless Jigsaw
products.blurb: Key specs: 18V brushless, 0-2,900 SPM variable speed, 4-position orbital.
strengths: 4-position orbital at a lower price than Milwaukee or DEWALT
2,900 SPM max speed handles most softwood and plywood cuts efficiently
T-shank blade compatibility -- most blade brands are T-shank
Metabo HPT (former Hitachi) tools have excellent motor longevity
limitations: Smaller ecosystem than Milwaukee or DEWALT
Less brand recognition for resale value
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: WEN 20670 Brushless Cordless Jigsaw with Auto-Speed
products.blurb: Key specs: 20V Max battery, Brushless motor with auto-speed, Tool-free bevel adjustment.
strengths: Brushless motor at an entry-level price point -- longer runtime and motor life than brushed competitors
Auto-speed feature adjusts stroke speed automatically based on material resistance
LED work light included at this price tier
Adequate for plywood, thin softwood, and light DIY tasks
limitations: Smaller battery ecosystem than the major professional brands
Motor struggles in thick hardwood compared to a full-power professional jigsaw
